
for (col in 1:ncol(wide_df)) {
  thisVar <- wide_df[, col]
  varname <- names(thisVar)
  
  # THIS IS ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED OR IT BREAKS ALONG WITH THE {{chunk_label} IN MultipleSlider_B.Rmd}
  chunk_label <- paste0("slider_", varname)
  
  question_text <- responseKey$definition[
    responseKey$question == question_id & 
    responseKey$value == varname
  ]

  out3 <- paste(
    out3,
    knit_expand(
      file = "DataTypes/MultipleSlider_B.Rmd",
      question_text = question_text,
      chunk_label = chunk_label
    )
  )
}
